name: TardiGeddon
storyline: Tardigrades can survive boiling, freezing, radiation and the vacuum of space. So when rival colonies of water bears go to war, nothing short of a Concrete Tun will settle it. Last tardi standing wins.
summary: TardiGeddon is a free turn-based artillery game starring tardigrades, the toughest animals on Earth. Teams take turns to walk, aim and fire across destructible maps, allowing for the wind, with 29 weapons from the Spore Bazooka to the Concrete Tun. Every match is a new map in one of 7 styles, from floating Sky Realms to tunnel-riddled Caverns. Play against the computer at four difficulty levels, with up to 10 teams on one device, or online with friends, plus a new daily challenge with leaderboards. It plays in any modern browser on computers, phones and tablets, with no download, no ads, and nothing to buy that helps you win.
